title: Streaming Logit Entropy
prompt:
A language-model monitor needs the entropy of a token distribution, even when its logits arrive in blocks.

- `entropy_from_logits(logits)`: given a non-empty 1D list or NumPy array, return the natural-log entropy of its softmax distribution.
- `streaming_entropy(blocks)`: given an iterable of non-empty 1D logit blocks, return the entropy of the combined distribution using `O(1)` extra state besides the current block. Do not retain all logits.

Both functions must remain numerically stable for large logits. Reject empty input or an empty block; `assert` is sufficient. NumPy is available.
